study: Pose-Center Feasibility Audit for Observability-Aware Amodal Box Completion
cohort: All 416 physical frames and 832 sealed Qwen replies used by the prior pose study. Exposed evaluation. Validation 288, separate recording extension 128, overlap-aware recording-separated aggregate 224 relative to the original 96. No model calls, training, new recordings or FINAL. GT only after sealing predictions.
isolation: Reconstruct the exact prior blind fit-tree node and fit/selection/audit folds of 4x4 projection cells. Fit points exclude both reserved folds by original return identity. Pose, dimensions and center use the same fit node and the previous fixed-size yaw anchors. All ray cohorts are nearest-return in the frozen Qwen window and attributed by the same region rule. Selection rays only compare the computed hypotheses. Audit rays only evaluate them. Use camera-centered first-box-intersection optical depths as a proxy for physical visibility.
exact_domain: For each yaw and fixed Qwen dimensions, intersect the individual point containment intervals along local box axes. Report strict interval from actual extrema, and robust approximate interval from marginal 5th and 95th percentiles expanded by 0.05 m per side. Empty domains remain empty. Retain fallbacks and count measured support outside the final box. Marginal trimming supplies no joint inlier guarantee.
solver: Use at most 128 evenly indexed fit window cells, minimum five. Use mean absolute first-face optical-depth residual clipped to max(0.1 m, half Qwen short horizontal side), with the same cap for a miss, and fixed 0.05 m tolerances defined before this run. Single-stage grid plus two bounded continuous Powell starts (5 samples per axis, 120 evaluations per start). The ordinary continuous comparison uses the same loss, starts and rays, with an envelope of at least plus/minus one fixed box extent around the normal anchor but without robust containment bounds. Both pure search methods use the same visible-face anchor, and tie-break exact minima by proximity to it.
observation_aware: At the best bounded center, locate the active entering face of each hit whose optical-depth error is at most 0.05 m. An axis is locally supported if three or more such rays have that active face, ignoring exact ties. Keep its estimated center unchanged. For the other axes, project the raw Qwen center into the intersection of the robust center box and a conservative local interval that preserves each reliable hit's first depth within 0.05 m of that fitted entry. The interval contains the fitted entry point of each such ray and forbids moving its previous active face in front by more than the same depth tolerance. Check the mean fit loss stays within 0.05 m of that pose minimum. Backtrack the prior move if needed. Report the sampled global near-minimum set over both poses (fit cost at most best +0.05 m) and its witness widths, and distinguish those widths from exact containment bounds. Record candidate feasible widths and hit assignment support separately.
arms: A baseline is exact sealed full C_E_Qsize. Face controls are exact prior blind-fit fixed-dimension PCA, fixed Qwen yaw and two-candidate ray winner. Ordinary continuous has fixed-PCA, fixed-Qwen and joint arms. Feasible-only uses bounded center search with the same two yaws and selection, with no Qwen center correction or yaw tie priority. B and C are observation-aware optimized center at fixed PCA and Qwen yaw respectively. D compares the same candidates using a fit near-minimum gate and selection rays, and uses the Qwen pose prior when the selection E difference is within 0.05 m. A matched readout also disables that yaw tie priority. Single-scale reports the sealed level-7 anchor and OABC on the level-7 blind fit tree. Infeasible fixed-pose arms fall back to their matched fixed-size face box. Joint arms fall back to the matched face winner when no joint solve is usable or selection has fewer than five returns.
postseal_E: For both pose hypotheses, report actual center inclusion in strict and robust boxes and at the ray tolerance, and recompute robust inclusion using only GT size, only GT yaw, or both with the same region. Record annotated point support fraction. Report sampled best-IoU robust and near-loss hypotheses, including GT-center projections scored offline and admitted only by the same predicates. These are finite witness oracles, not certified global IoU optima. Report fraction of wrong predictions with true center in domain, and rescue missed relative to the witness oracle. Report per-axis feasible width and center error relationship in all robust-feasible cases, along with pose/center ambiguity.
decision: Preserve the registered baseline until the new mechanism beats matched ordinary continuous geometry and the fixed two-candidate method, has supportive platform-level behavior, and is replicated on new recordings. This phase distinguishes missing support or wrong priors from inability to select within available geometry. No label-driven tolerance or pose selection. All invalid or unsolved frames remain in denominators.
